methods: ONS Census 2021 PP002 Sex, all persons, measure Value (20100), reference 21 March 2021; primarily UPRN-to-parish best-fit, with postcode allocation where needed, using December 2022 parish boundaries. These are ONS-published parish census estimates with targeted record swapping and cell-key perturbation, not unadjusted exact enumerated counts and not output-area best-fit aggregates. No OA totals or sex categories are summed.

Count replacements additionally require exact stored-count equality with official Nomis Census 2011 KS101EW/QS101EW or Census 2001 KS001 for the same parish, with identical code or CHD proof of no intervening boundary change. All 22 review-2132 settlement/parish conflicts are held unconditionally. Year-only rows retain the build 1 gates. Use only the row own literal nondeprecated Wikidata E04/W04 P836 code and parish/community P31 at Census Day and retrieval, matching the official 2021 boundary, the December 2022 PP002 geography and the live May 2026 parish register. Require the same official English/Welsh name after case, spacing, punctuation and Saint/St normalization (no fuzzy word matching), and strict original-point containment in valid full-resolution 2021 and 2022 polygons in EPSG:27700. Official 2021 parish-to-LAD and LAD-to-county lookups bind the row own stored state; E10 counties, metropolitan districts and unitary authorities retain their respective ISO state roles. Check current parish parent as well. Valid state polygons are an additional consistency check; invalid state polygons are not repaired or used, and state membership follows exact official parish containment and hierarchy instead. Reject any post-Census-Day reorganisation/code edge or non-live code from ONS CHD, ambiguous own codes, item/name conflicts, shared items, newer stored observations and unproved unresolved v4.0 continuity. Stale pre-2021 own codes are never successor bridges; only a unique own code live in 2021 and today may bind.
